author: Reuters
description:
British actor Tom Blyth, who is making his Broadway debut in “A Few Good Men,” says the story's exploration of masculinity, power and the institutions people trust for safety and care resonates more strongly today, amid what he describes as a broader reckoning in the United States.
 
The play that launched Aaron Sorkin's writing career centers around military lawyers defending two Marines accused of murder at the US naval base at Guantanamo Bay, Cuba, as they uncover a cover-up involving the chain of command.

description:
Mummies from ancient Egypt are set to haunt the British capital this Halloween at the London Dungeon. The tourist landmark by the River Thames is running an Egypt-themed performance titled “Curse of the Mummy” with guests encountering props like bandaged corpses and religious totems, alongside performers in full costume.
